interpretations: Emergency cases show HIGHER clinical gate activation, indicating the model prioritizes clinical expertise match when urgency is high.
Emergency cases also elevate logistics gate, suggesting proximity and availability become critical in emergencies.
Rare disease cases increase pastwork gate activation, reflecting the importance of research publications and specialized experience for rare conditions.
Complex multi-comorbidity cases activate BOTH clinical and pastwork gates highly, indicating the model recognizes that both expertise match and experience matter.
